items.title: What If the Fed Doubles the Rate Hike in December? These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Prosper
items.summary: Markets say a quarter-point hike is nearly certain, but a hot inflation print could change that fast. Five dividend payers, from banks to an oil giant to a toothpaste maker, each win in a different way if the Fed gets aggressive.

items.title: Procter & Gamble Has Raised Its Dividend for 70 Straight Years. Where’s the Price Target Now?

items.title: Oil set for second weekly loss amid easing fears of fresh U.S.-Iran fighting
